🌟 Simple-Organizer | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the organization of files on a user's computer system.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic file organization • Sub-categories • Rules engine • Multi-level undo • Auto-scheduling
📖 Summary: Simple Organizer is a Python-based application for automatic file organization on Linux and Windows. It offers features like sub-categorization, a rules engine, undo functionality, scheduling, and duplicate detection/deletion, all designed for safety and reliability with no internet or background services required.

🚀 edentext | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A private, local-first, feature-rich word processing application accessible through a web browser, designed for creating and editing documents without server-side processing or data transmission.
✨ Key Features:
📖 Summary: EdenText is a powerful, free, and open-source web-based word processor designed for local-first operation. It allows users to create and edit documents in .docx and .odt formats directly in their browser, ensuring privacy as all processing happens client-side and documents never leave the user's computer. It aims to provide a rich feature set comparable to desktop applications while being accessible via a single URL or as a slim offline app.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ dlss5-visual-enhancer | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: AI-assisted enhancement of images and videos using NVIDIA DLSS technologies on Windows.
✨ Key Features: • DLSS 5 Neural Rendering via Neuroframe Engine • Configurable image and video processing pipelines • DLSS Super Resolution • NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution • NVIDIA RTX Video HDR
📖 Summary: Visual Enhancer is a Windows application that leverages NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering and other AI upscaling technologies for enhancing the quality of images and videos. It offers a configurable pipeline with stages like DLSS Super Resolution, RTX Video Super Resolution, and Frame Generation, with live playback capabilities for local and online content.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 apex-parser | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with curated and categorized lists of functional proxy servers for bypassing censorship and enhancing internet freedom.
✨ Key Features: • Proxy parsing and management • Categorization into Whitelist, Blacklist, and Full List • Support for multiple output formats (Base64, Plain, YAML) • Distribution via GitHub raw content and CDNs • Telegram bot integration for access
📖 Summary: The apex-parser repository is a Python-based tool designed to parse and manage lists of proxy servers. It categorizes proxies into whitelist, blacklist, and a full list, offering them in various formats like Base64, Plain, and YAML. The project aims to facilitate internet freedom by providing access to functional proxy lists.
